name: Ananias
summary: A devout disciple in Damascus whom the Lord sent to Saul after Saul lost his sight. Though he had heard of the evil Saul had done, he obeyed, laid his hands on him, and Saul could see again.

key_moments.title: Called in a Vision
key_moments.description: The Lord told Ananias in a vision to go to the street called Straight and find Saul of Tarsus, who was praying. Ananias said he had heard of the evil Saul had done, but the Lord said Saul was His chosen vessel to carry His name to the Gentiles.

key_moments.title: Lays His Hands on Saul
key_moments.description: Ananias went in, laid his hands on Saul, and called him brother, saying Jesus had sent him so that Saul could see again and the Holy Ghost would fill him. Something like scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see, and he was baptized.
